before.title: Upcoming Changes - Jailbreak Detection in Authenticator App
before.description: Starting February 2026, Microsoft Authenticator will introduce jailbreak/root detection for Microsoft Entra credentials in the Authenticator app. The rollout progresses from warning mode to blocking mode. Users must move to compliant devices to continue using Microsoft Entra accounts in Authenticator.
